segments.name: Consumer wellness
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, markets and sells supplement brands powered by natural compounds, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, for consumers and pets.
segments.evidence: cbdMD, Inc. is a consumer wellness company focused on the development, manufacturing, marketing, and sale of supplement brands powered by natural compounds.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and retail/wholesale channel partners pay the company for cannabinoid and functional wellness products sold through e-commerce, online marketplaces, wholesale and specialty channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold through a diversified distribution network that includes direct-to-consumer e-commerce platforms, online marketplaces, wholesale distribution to national and regional retailers, specialty health and pet channels, and emerging international markets.
